overall_narrative_summary: Main article full text is not accessible in the provided source text. Although retrieval status is marked retrieved_cached_pdf, the 15-page cached PDF consists exclusively of the Supplemental Material file: four trailing World Health Organization reference entries (PDF p. 1), Supplemental Material Part 1a (a blank bi-monthly questionnaire for tracking operational, financial, institutional, and water-supply impact indicators in Bushenyi-Ishaka; PDF pp. 1-3), Supplemental Material Part 1b (a blank quarterly questionnaire/interview guide effective August 2018 probing respondent opinions on weather, disease outbreaks, technology changes, power failures, political events, demand shifts, regulatory/by-law pressure, budgetary changes, and system challenges; PDF pp. 3-13), and Supplemental Material Parts 2a and 2b headings covering July 2018 to March 2021 with unextracted table bodies (PDF pp. 14-15). Because the main manuscript (Abstract, Introduction, Methods, Results, and Discussion) is completely absent, the empirical study design (e.g., whether a comparator utility was analyzed vs. a single-utility mixed-methods longitudinal case evaluation), sampling strategy, respondent recruitment, response/completion rates, analytical adjustments for confounding, and actual outcome data cannot be verified. Per review rules prohibiting guessing from citations or incomplete supplements, chosen_tool, overall_rating, and all seven cross-tool bias domains are set to cannot_tell.
